name: cysteinyl leukotriene receptor 2

function.text: CYSLTR2 encodes cysteinyl leukotriene receptor 2. Annotated molecular activities include galanin receptor activity and leukotriene receptor activity. It participates in immune response and neuropeptide signaling pathway.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Uveal melanoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
